summary.en: Match your footage to advertising copy, time shots to narration, and apply editable text presets.
summary.zh-CN: 从素材中选取与文案相关的片段，按配音时长剪辑，应用可编辑文字样式。

details.en: For footage-based fitness, service and product promos. Reuses existing tools and local fonts; keeps simple tracks and records native versus rendered draft effects. Uses supplied narration or a configured TTS service.
details.zh-CN: 适合健身、服务介绍、产品宣传等素材剪辑广告。复用现有工具和内置字体，保持简洁分轨，记录选片依据和原生／预渲染效果。支持已有录音或已配置的TTS；不会自动开通付费服务。
